# Black and White Stays Staycation Workation Villa Apartment

## Overview
Black and White Stays offers a unique staycation and workation experience in Kerala, specifically in Wayanad and Kalpetta. The accommodations include villas, apartments, and homestays, catering to tourists and vacationers looking for a serene getaway.

## Main Links
- [Black & White](https://www.bwstays.com/index.html): The main page for Black and White Stays, providing an overview of services and offerings.
- [About](https://www.bwstays.com/#about): Information about the establishment, its mission, and the experiences it offers.
- [Discover](https://www.bwstays.com/#projects): A guide to exploring the local attractions and activities available in the area.
- [Contact](https://www.bwstays.com/#signup): BW Stays Contact for inquiries and reservations.

## Accommodations
- [Reservations - Black and White Wayanad](https://www.bwstays.com/booking.html): Details on how to book your stay at Black and White Wayanad.

## Local Attractions
### Waterfalls and Natural Sites
- [Kanthanpara Falls - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_kanthanpara_waterfall_wayanad.html): A picturesque waterfall ideal for sightseeing and photography.
- [Soochipara Falls - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_soochipara_waterfall_wayanad.html): A popular spot for nature lovers and adventure seekers.
- [Meenmutty Falls - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_meenmutty_waterfall_wayanad.html): Known for its stunning views and trekking opportunities.
- [Arripara falls - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_arripara_waterfall_wayanad.html): A serene location perfect for relaxation and enjoying nature.
- [Irrupu falls - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_Irrupu_waterfall_wayanad.html): A beautiful waterfall surrounded by lush greenery.

### Cultural and Historical Sites
- [Ananthanatha Swamy Jain Temple Pilgrimage](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_ananthanatha_swamy_jain_temple_pilgrimage_wayanad.html): A significant religious site for pilgrims and tourists.
- [Meenangadi Church Pilgrimage - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_meenangadi_church_pilgrimage_wayanad.html): A historic church attracting visitors for its architecture and spiritual significance.
- [Sita Devi Temple Pilgrimage - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_pulpally_sitadevi_temple_pilgrimage_wayanad.html): A temple known for its cultural importance.

### Wildlife and Nature reserve
- [Nagarhole wild life sanctuary - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_nagarhole_wildlife_sanctuary_wayanad.html): A sanctuary known for its diverse flora and fauna.
- [Pakshipathalam wild life sanctuary - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_pakshipathalam_wildlife_sanctuary_wayanad.html): A haven for bird watchers and wildlife enthusiasts.

### Tea Estates and Farms
- [Rippon Tea Estate Cycling - Black and White Wayanad](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_rippon_teaestate_cycling_wayanad.html): An opportunity for cycling enthusiasts to explore tea plantations.
- [Rippon Tea estate Plantation - Black and White Wayanad](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_rippon_tea_estate_plantation_wayanad.html): A visit to a tea estate to learn about tea production.
- [Ambalavayal Farm - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_ambalavayal_farm_rars_wayanad.html): A farm experience showcasing local agriculture.

### Unique Experiences
- [Honey Museum - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_honey_museum_wayanad.html): A museum dedicated to the art of beekeeping and honey production.
- [Bamboo Forest Valentine's Park - Black and White Wayanad Kalpetta](https://www.bwstays.com/bw_bamboo_forest_valentine_park_wayanad.html): A romantic park featuring bamboo groves and scenic views.
